audience.public_segment: South African schools, tutors, extra-class providers and education publishers
audience.internal_buyer_unit: Education Publishing; Digital Products; Partnerships; Rights/Content Operations

hypothesis: If Publishers Association of South Africa (PASA) is shown 'One-topic companion proof: beautiful guided-learning pack + visual resource + practice sheet + HOMS assessment/memo from the same curriculum spine.', then the Curriculum/content decision-maker is more likely to request a bounded pilot because the offer addresses a specific workflow pain without surrendering human authority.

experiment.channel: Partnership/demo request through current public association route
experiment.proof_summary: HOMS assessment and CAPS controls plus NicheFoundry media production can be combined; a connected one-topic guide, activity, worksheet, assessment, memo and video proof remains the release gate.
experiment.public_hook: One curriculum spine should drive the explanation, activity, worksheet, assessment, memo and optional video lesson.
experiment.cta: Nominate one subject, grade, term and topic for a controlled companion-pack pilot.
experiment.kill_condition: No qualified engagement after two permission-safe attempts or channel test; re-evaluate message/fit before any further approach.

gates.reason: Research and proof-content generation are allowed; no valid electronic sales permission is recorded.
